info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Finance Financial Statement-spec
info.description: The Financial Statement Management API facilitates the creation of financial statements for banking applications. Designed for finance professionals and developers, this API optimally handles the submission of various financial data, ensuring compliance and accuracy in reporting. With capabilities to support multiple financial scenarios, users can easily integrate this service into their existing systems for streamlined financial operations. Common use cases include generating financial reports, providing insights for audits, or meeting regulatory requirements.

post.description: This operation allows you to create a new financial statement for your organization, capturing relevant financial data that can be used for reporting and analysis.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit financial statement data for processing. The payload should contain the necessary details about the financial statements being submitted, following the specified schema. Ensure that the data included adheres to the expected structure to avoid validation errors.

201.description: Resource created successfully, indicating the financial statement was successfully generated.
